description: exchange_aging (phase age): while same-epoch Provider input is at or above the watermark, one rewrite ages every exchange older than the exact exchange tail into recoverable references, once a batch of exchanges has left that tail since the last aging.

trigger_tokens.description: Absolute watermark in same-epoch Provider input tokens, capped by the ratio; below emergency_checkpoint's.

trigger_ratio.description: The watermark's cap as a share of the hard input limit; below emergency_checkpoint's.

exact_tail_exchanges.description: Latest exchanges an aging keeps exact, and the batch: an aging waits until this many have left the exact tail since the last one.

argument_bytes.description: An aged tool call's arguments longer than this (UTF-8 bytes) become a recoverable reference. null: arguments never age (nor does their message, so its reasoning stays bound).

result_bytes.description: An aged tool result longer than this (UTF-8 bytes) becomes a preview and a recoverable reference.

preview.description: What an aged argument or result keeps beside its reference: its head and its tail, never splitting a character, around a marker of the bytes cut between them.

result_preview.description: What an aged result keeps beside its reference; absent: head_and_tail (the preview). structured: its status fields (ok, status, exit code, actions executed), the error type and message of a failed one, and its size, no output text.

keep_anchor.description: With an exact tail in exchanges: leave the anchor exchange (the latest robot action's call, receipt and observation) as it is, however old; absent: false.
